description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
If Kiora's Follower has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
If Fatestitcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Hawkeye's Bow
uses.cardState: attached to either Kiora's Follower or Fatestitcher
